examples.arabic: لاحظت سارة ان الفستان الذي اشترته لم يكن مناسبا لها
examples.english: Sarah noticed that the dress she bought was not suitable for her
examples.transliteration: Lahazat Sarah anna al-fustan alladhi ishtarat-hu lam yakun munasiban laha

examples.arabic: شعرت مريم ببعض التردد قبل ان تعيد الفستان الى المحل
examples.english: Maryam felt some hesitation before returning the dress to the shop.
examples.transliteration: Sha'arat Maryam bi-ba'd at-taraddud qabl an tu'id al-fustan ila al-mahall.

examples.arabic: اجابت لينا انا بخير شكرا لك وبدأت تبحث عن فستان جميل
examples.english: Lina replied, "I am fine, thank you," and started looking for a beautiful dress.
examples.transliteration: Ajabat Lina ana bi-khayr shukran laki wa bada'at tabhathu 'an fustanun jameel.

examples.arabic: جربت الفستان وكان المقاس مناسبا جدا
examples.english: I tried on the dress and the size was very suitable.
examples.transliteration: Jarrabtu al-fustan wa kana al-miqas munasiban jiddan
